mapper.select: select kc.korean_card_id as cardId, kc.korean_word as koreanWord, fc.foreign_word as foreign_word, kc.level as level, fc.language_code as language_code, kc.original_language as original_language, kc.homograph_number as homograph_number, kc.parts_of_speech as parts_of_speech, kc.pronunciation as pronunciation, kc.related_words as related_words, kc.inflection as inflection, kc.example_usage as example_usage from foreign_cards fc join korean_cards kc on fc.korean_card_id = kc.korean_card_id where fc.foreign_word like '%${queryText}%' LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ;
